name: Malaga TechPark 100MW data center campus
notes: Junta de Andalucia declared the Malaga TechPark project of strategic interest; the campus is planned as Tier III/Tier III+ with about 100MW IT capacity and up to 150MW electrical demand.

name: Alto Infrastructure SP01 Granada AI data center
notes: SP01 in Escuzar, Granada is a high-density AI campus; first phase is expected in summer 2027 at 10MW IT, scaling to 25MW in 2027 and about 70MW IT at full build by late 2029.

name: Templus Malaga MAL01
notes: Operational Malaga colocation facility in the Guadalhorce area; Templus/press reporting says expansion tripled power to about 3MW and added a new data room.

name: Templus Sevilla SEV01
notes: Operational Sevilla data center at PICA Business Park; Templus lists 370 sqm IT space and total power of 1MW after acquisition/relaunch.

name: AWS Europe (Spain) Region expansion in Aragon
notes: AWS operates its Spain cloud region in Aragon and announced a 2024 expansion investment of EUR15.7bn, increased in 2026 as part of EUR33.7bn planned Spain data-center infrastructure investment.

name: Microsoft Aragon datacenter campuses
notes: Microsoft says its Aragon virtual room covers permits for planned datacenters; reporting cites initial PIGA approval for campuses in La Muela, Villamayor de Gallego and Zaragoza.

name: QTS Calatorao data center campus
notes: QTS official site lists its first Spain campus on a 224-hectare site in Calatorao, Zaragoza province; data-center listings report up to 300MW electrical capacity.

name: Tillion Zaragoza data center
notes: Azora/Tillion announced a Zaragoza DC with initial secured capacity of 150MW, expandable to 300MW, and up to EUR2bn infrastructure investment.

name: SAMCA Zaragoza data center campus
notes: SAMCA's Zaragoza campus was approved as a Project of General Interest of Aragon; plans call for three data centers, an initial 131MW phase and possible scale-up to 300MW.

name: Vantage Zaragoza / Villanueva de Gallego campus
developer: Vantage Data Centers / Desarrollos Ecoindustriales La Cartuja
notes: Vantage announced a EUR3.2bn hyperscale campus in Villanueva de Gallego, Zaragoza, to be developed over ten years in five phases on roughly 40 hectares.

name: Digital Valley Asturias - Salas campus
developer: Digital Valley Asturias / S4U with Principality of Asturias
notes: Project at Nonaya industrial park in Salas proposes ten data center modules, 120MW final computing capacity, substation and small PV installation; construction expected between H2 2027 and 2030.

name: Altamira Data Center campus
developer: Stoneshield Capital / XDC Properties; Sener/Quark design
notes: Sener describes a 500MW Cantabria data center campus, one of Europe's largest, with construction expected to begin in Q1 2025 and operations from 2032; Quark says it consists of 12 adjacent 40MW modules.

name: Templus Ceuta CEU01
notes: First Ceuta data center, located in the port at Puntilla dock; initial 1.2MW and 2,500 sqm, expected to become operational in H1 2026 with possible expansion to 2.4MW.

name: DC Mudarra Torrelobaton data center
notes: Planned Torrelobaton, Valladolid campus would include two 80MW buildings for a total of 160MW and an estimated EUR1.6bn-EUR2bn investment.

name: Social Security CPD Soria
developer: Spain Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration
notes: Public-sector data processing center in Los Royales, Soria; official Social Security notice covered the construction license and DCD reported the project above 80 percent complete in 2026.

name: Meta Talavera de la Reina Data Center Campus
notes: Castilla-La Mancha territorial planning portal lists the Meta Data Center Campus PSI; project is in Talavera de la Reina/Torrehierro, with secondary sources reporting phased buildout toward 2030 and about 248MW.

name: DC Malpica AI - Mora, Toledo
developer: EdgeMode / BlackBerry AIF / Mora Town Council partners
notes: Mora/Toledo AI data center campus proposal presented to Castilla-La Mancha government; developers describe a EUR3bn, 300MW project seeking priority-project status.

name: Nostrum GUA1 Guadalajara data center
developer: Nostrum Data Centers / Ingenostrum; IDOM design
notes: Nostrum GUA1 in Guadalajara has two hectares of land and 40MWe of guaranteed power; construction planned for late 2026 and operation estimated during 2028.

name: Fortinet Guadalajara data center
notes: Fortinet announced opening its first Spain data center in Guadalajara, Castilla-La Mancha, to support European service delivery and cybersecurity services.

name: Grupo Aire OASIX Toledo data center
notes: Operational OASIX Toledo data center listed as opened in 2022, around 800 sqm with more than 54 racks; included as a smaller regional facility.

name: D-ALiX Tenerife data center
notes: D-ALiX at Granadilla, Tenerife is an operational neutral access point, submarine cable station and data center; third-party specs list 5MW and 2,000 sqm.

name: Grupo Aire OASIX Las Palmas data center
notes: Carrier-neutral Las Palmas de Gran Canaria facility at Av. Juan XXIII 44, operational since 2010, with about 235 sqm and more than 50 racks for colocation/cloud/interconnection.

name: Telefonica Tech VDC node in Tenerife data center
notes: Telefonica Tech deployed a Virtual Data Center node in the Tenerife data center to serve Canary Islands enterprises and public administrations with local cloud services.

name: Ark Data Centres Barcelona / La Maquinista
notes: Ark's first Spain development is planned in Barcelona's La Maquinista area, on about 30,000 sqm of industrial land, with up to 45MW IT capacity and over EUR600m investment.

name: Equinix BA2 Barcelona IBX
notes: Operational BA2 IBX in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat adjacent to BA1; Equinix lists 27,147 sq ft and 100 percent renewable energy coverage, while DCD reported 3.4MW capacity.

name: Templus Barcelona BCN01 / bitNAP
notes: Templus acquired bitNAP's Barcelona data center in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat; facility spans more than 3,000 sqm and has 1.7MW capacity, with roadmap to double IT capacity.

name: Nostrum Evergreen / BAZ-01 Badajoz data center
notes: Nostrum Evergreen/BAZ-01 at Badajoz logistics platform is planned in phases from 2026; AECOM says first phase is 150MWe and second phase reaches 300MWe, with design scalable to 500MWe.

name: Ingenostrum CC Green Caceres data center
notes: Early Extremadura hyperscale project in Caceres/Las Capellanias eco-park; DCD reported a 150MW carbon-neutral data center, while later listings show the CC Green/Nostrum Caceres campus seeking larger grid capacity.

name: Merlin Properties / Edged Extremadura AI campuses
developer: Merlin Properties / Edged Energy / Government of Extremadura
notes: Merlin/Edged and Extremadura government signed to promote two large AI data center campuses using waterless cooling and green energy; secondary reporting locates them around Navalmoral de la Mata and Valdecaballeros.
